cover_headline: ICICI Bank Profit Jumps 20% to Rs 14,843 Crore in Second Quarter

end.headline: ICICI Bank Profit Jumps 20% to Rs 14,843 Crore in Second Quarter
end.line: Net interest income rose 17.7% to Rs 25,339 crore, gross NPA fell to 1.20% and loans grew 30%, as India's second-largest private lender beat profit estimates.

facts: ICICI Bank's standalone net profit rose 20.1% year on year to Rs 14,843 crore in the quarter ended September 30, 2026, beating the Rs 14,251 crore analysts expected
Net interest income rose 17.7% to Rs 25,339 crore, while the gross NPA ratio improved to 1.20% and the net NPA ratio fell to 0.30%
Loans grew 30% and deposits 27.1% year on year, and capital adequacy stood at 16.68% with CET-1 at 16.01%
